//: The one place both doors into this suite are configured. `npm run test:unit` is the door CI runs and `scripts/run-unit.mjs` is the door dabbler.yaml declares; mocha finds this file from the package directory either way, so the compiler hook, the vscode stub and the per-user-records arming are stated once and neither door can drop one by being edited alone. `spec` is deliberately absent: mocha MERGES a configured spec with an appended path list rather than being narrowed by it (D116), so a glob here would turn every targeted run into a whole-suite run. Each door names its own.
